owner_decisions_applied.categories: Preserve existing 6 categories strictly. Do not create 7th Accessories category. Unsuitable accessories marked UNASSIGNED — OWNER REVIEW REQUIRED.
owner_decisions_applied.glass_sipper_handle_250_price: Single-piece price set to printed box MRP ₹275 (27,500 paise) instead of WhatsApp crossed-out ₹299. Discounted ₹110, price per 100 ₹11,000 (1,100,000 paise).
owner_decisions_applied.variant_grouping: Group related capacities as variants where feasible. Technical audit revealed variant wholesale per-100 price is not yet supported in current schema/UI. Dual preview models provided.

d1_schema_support.limitation: The product_variants table does NOT have expected_price_per_100_paise. Wholesale pricing per variant cannot be stored in the current schema without migration.

backend_api_support.limitation: functions/_shared/product-validation.js drops or rejects expected_price_per_100_paise on variants.

frontend_ui_support.limitation: ProductDetail.jsx only displays the parent product expected_price_per_100_paise; ProductForm.jsx has zero variant controls; ImageGallery does not filter by variant.

technical_variant_audit.recommendation: Use Model A (Independent Catalogue Products) for immediate production launch with 100% verified wholesale pricing, or execute Migration 0007 in Phase 12 to enable wholesale variant fields across D1 and React.
